profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Information Systems professional with over 20 years experience finding unique solutions to customer problems. Business experience includes Manufacturing, Inventory, Distribution, Health care and Waste Management systems. Technical background includes a wide variety of hardware and software platforms from AS/400 to Linux and Windows

Specialties: RPG, ILE RPG, CL, SQL, DDS:

positions.title: Contract programmer
positions.description: Designed, wrote and documented client-requested modifications to packaged Waste Management software.

positions.title: Contract Programmer
positions.description: Integrate AS/400 Saturn parts database and web-based Saturn dealership management software through an XML formatted API. Performed Analysis and Design phases following client software development life cycle.

positions.title: Contract Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Designed, wrote and documented client-requested modifications to packaged waste management software

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Designed, wrote and documented Warranty Management System (per contract)

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Wrote SQL stored procedure interface to allow ASP (Active server Pages) to access AS/400 data and programs.
Replaced six different time and attendance systems with a single web-based time clock and labor reporting system.
Performed AS/400 troubleshooting as needed to support the existing infrastructure.
Wrote a simplified callable interface for the AS/400 LDAP client API.
AZ Automotive

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Wrote and documented recursive process to relieve inventory according to an indented bill of materials.
Modified EDI reports to enable easier invoice matching.
Created alternate JBA environments to allow simultaneous daily operation and Chapter 11 resolution.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Provided on-site client support in installing, configuring and supporting Commerce One's BuySite application.
Designed, developed and documented ASP (Active Server pages) to customize the behavior of Commerce One's BuySite application.

positions.title: Consulting Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Successfully utilized CMM level 3 process (Roadmap) to implement ERP for a glass distribution company.
Analyst on migration project to the new Y2K compliant release of the Payroll and Hospital Management software.
Retrofitted customer requested modifications for a medical application package. Created new features and functionality for a new release of patient tracking, billing and payroll applications.
Integrated custom modifications into multiple release levels of JDE software.
Modified files in JDE package to work with a new Canadian division.

positions.title: M.I.S Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for all aspects of information processing and strategic technology application.
Enhanced, modified and maintained all AS/400 applications.
Renegotiated telephone service - reduced phone expense by 60%.
Installed network technology to architectural department reducing drawing plot time by 90%. Cut drawing time by 50%.

positions.title: Senior Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Implemented multi-language, multi-currency conversion project.
Designed and implemented a menu system to provide secure, easy-to-maintain access for AS400 users.
Utilities coordinator (volunteer position)
Implemented problem reporting and resolution system.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Implemented AT&T mailing system which cut programming time by 80% and improved turn-around time by 50%.
Redesigned and rewrote "Mail Magic" application. Saved doubtful account and improved customer trust by 100%

positions.title: DP Manager
positions.description:
Handled budget, purchasing decisions and supervised operator.
Installed MAPICS upgrade.
Designed and implemented a purchase order and fulfillment system.
Implemented inventory system changes.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Designed, wrote and documented an asynchronous charge posting system for updating guest accounts. System reduced record waits and record locks by 100%. Later extended application to interface with an AT&T 385 for posting telephone charges and a PC controller for posting charges from in-room refrigerator/bars.
Designed wrote and documented a simple query and report generator for sales and marketing. This resulted in the restructuring of room rates and increase in profitability of 1.5%.
